culture.summary: The Jailyard Dynasty group chat is a 12-member WhatsApp group that migrated from iMessage in September 2023. The chat peaks during NFL season months (September-January) with 1000-2400 messages per month, dropping to 38-180 in the deep offseason (May-June). The group's culture revolves around competitive trash talk, prediction receipts, trade debates, and a rich vocabulary of inside jokes. The tanking/Sacko discourse is the league's most enduring controversy.

CA lemon law has always been consumer friendly (e.g. consumer is entitled to attorney fees in they “prevail”, but not the other way around; availability of civil penalties of up to two times actual damages for “wilful failure” to comply with lemon law), but the recent massive year to year increase of lemon law lawsuit filings is a result of a much more aggressive LL consumer attorney bar. They are not only filing more cases but are also adding additional claims like fraud and unfair business practices that holds up resolution of the case (essentially holding the statutorily defined LL claims and its damages hostage because of the availability of punitive damages. 
Additionally, recent appellate law in the area is mostly plaintiff friendly is very impactful. For example, a recent CA Supreme Court cases found that auto manufacturers are not entitled to a monetary set off if the plaintiff sells/trades in their vehicle or receives receives insurance proceeds for an accident. This means that a plaintiff, either before or after filing a lawsuit, can sell their vehicle and still receive full restitution for their vehicle, allowing for double recovery. 
Because the deck is so stacked against the auto companies, you see a lot more repurchase (or more) offers early in cases in an attempt to keep attorney fees down. It also means a lot more cases go to trial, because auto companies offer high statutory settlement offers and if plaintiff fails to beat the offer at trial, then attorney fees are cutoff and the auto company is entitled to some costs. I’ve had 2 jury trials in last 3 months and probably will have 2-3 more this year at a minimum. That’s quite a lot considering 99% of civil cases settle before trial.
